# Changelog

All notable changes are written here, newest first, in the sections of Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 (Added, Changed,
Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security). A muster's pack supplies its lines under Unreleased; the release moves them
under the version number.

## [Unreleased]
### Added
- A user can rate a resolved conversation from 1 to 5.
### Changed
- Reopening a conversation clears its rating.

## [1.0.0] - 2026-12-15
### Added
- A user can ask a question and get an answer that cites a source, and ask again.
- The bot hands a question it cannot answer to an agent with the reason; the agent accepts and closes it.
- A conversation is resolved by the user or by the agent, and can be reopened within 7 days.
